column1: to  establish  the  Securities  and  Exchange  Commission  of  Sri  Lanka;  to
regulate  market  institutions,  certain  public  offers  of  securities,  market
intermediaries;  to  protect  investors  and  to  provide  for  enforcement
measures; to deal with market misconduct; and to overcome the challenges
encountered by securities market regulators and to repeal the Securities
and  Exchange   Commission  of   Sri   Lanka  Act,  No. 36  of  1987  and  for
matters connected  therewith or  incidental  thereto.
